raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: ngmix-split
  version: "2.4.1"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/esheldon/ngmix/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2ad9fc4bfc7a1800f3aa1f841f3e6e256b5e0ab8376fcd0dbd44ee62f37f54e4

build:
  number: 2
  skip: win

outputs:
  - package:
      name: ngmix-core
    build:
      script:
        file: build_core.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: python
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
      run:
        - python
        - numpy
        - numba <0.41.0a|>=0.43.0,!=0.54.0  # bug in these numbas
        - scipy
        - galsim
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - ngmix
          pip_check: false
  - package:
      name: ngmix
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("ngmix-core", exact=True) }}
        - meds
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - ngmix
            - ngmix.medsreaders
          pip_check: false

about:
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  license_file: gpl.txt
  summary: Gaussian mixtures and image processing implemented in python and numba
  homepage: https://github.com/esheldon/ngmix

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - beckermr
